ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:2 ratio of high-intensity (white/water spray) to low-intensity (dark pigmentation) pixels across the visible surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged serrations along the trailing boundary of both lobes with high-frequency pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 5 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed concave-to-convex trajectory with an upward sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct near-vertical linear pixel disruption is visible on the interior of the right lobe, breaking the dark pigmentation pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular dark-grey protuberances and massing at the extreme terminal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive specular highlights and high-density water droplet scattering across the entire ventral fluke surface.
